criteria.question: Does it represent the whole world state?
criteria.sf_hd: every driver, rider, road; zone counts match the simulator 99.99%
criteria.note: hidden traits are not given; the model infers them from history

criteria.question: Does it predict the next 30 s as a calibrated distribution?
criteria.sf_hd: beats historical rates on 11/12 event heads
criteria.note: calibration close to the diagonal on every binary head (stage 2)

criteria.question: Does it stay on track over hours of its own predictions?
criteria.sf_hd: 8 h error: pickups 10%, online 11%; beats persistence 9/10, historical average 6/10
criteria.pune_hd: 8 h error: pickups 7%, online 4%; beats persistence 10/10, historical average 6/10
criteria.note: stage 8a; drifts high after ~3 h (requests +10%, cancellations +26-52%)

criteria.question: Do its imagined futures spread as much as reality?
criteria.note: draws too narrow: no day-level demand factor, and the drift above

criteria.question: Does it respond to the platform's actions as the world does?
criteria.sf_hd: repositioning orders: idle drivers at the target r 0.93
criteria.note: stage 4, fresh seasons; city-wide effects ~0 in both

criteria.question: Does it predict shocks it never saw?
criteria.sf_hd: supply60: pickups -102 real vs -80 model; price15: pickups -84 real vs -28 model
criteria.pune_hd: supply60: pickups -203 real vs -219 model; price15: pickups -492 real vs -124 model
criteria.note: stage 8b; supply cuts right in size, price rise right in sign but ~1/3 the size

criteria.question: Do policies built in imagination work, and rank, the same in the world?
criteria.sf_hd: rank corr. 0.72 over 11 policies; clear pairs same order 26/27
criteria.pune_hd: rank corr. 0.39 over 7 policies; clear pairs same order 2/2
criteria.note: agents trained in imagination match the rule in the simulator; imagination overrates the stage-7 menus

criteria.question: Does its representation help learn new tasks?
criteria.sf_hd: pretrained vs scratch agent +10 to +11 reward
criteria.note: stages 5-6; it also stays a predictor under RL (NLL 14.89 -> 15.12)

criteria.question: Does it work on new days and new people?
criteria.note: one model for both cities; not tried: a new city, new road network, a different fleet size from the start

criteria.question: How much of the dynamics is learned?
criteria.sf_hd: learned: every human decision and all demand
criteria.note: coded rules: driving on the road graph, routes, fares, surge, request lifecycle; traffic is the typical profile
